data.one_liner: Generates unique avatar widgets with optional animation and custom color palettes.
data.what_it_does: Provides BoringAvatar and AnimatedBoringAvatar widgets that create deterministic avatars from a name. Supports custom palettes, shapes, and can export the avatar as an image.
use_when: You need lightweight, deterministic avatars for user profiles
You want animated avatar transitions on name changes
You want easy customization of colors and shapes without external assets
avoid_when: You require complex image processing or networking
strengths: Fast rendering with canvas and caching
